title: HELIX Data Dictionary
description: Structured, importable data dictionary for all 47 HELIX Core resources across 9 domains. Every attribute includes data type, classification tier, FERPA/GLBA flags, and terminology bindings. Import into Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview, or AWS Glue Data Catalog.
